purpose: Keep preprocessing policy and estimator family as separate experimental axes under explicit information-access rules.

common_output_contract.composition_rule: Policies select only among immutable P01 arrays. They do not estimate a new transform.
common_output_contract.new_transform_rule: Any new transform or changed transform parameter requires a versioned P01 deviation and a complete P01 rebuild before P02 or model use.

policy_development_panel.reason: One fixed strong classical model and the ordinary compact deep baseline prevent a policy from being optimized only for the eventual winner.
policy_development_panel.selection_data: source-training masters and source pseudo-instrument validation domains only
policy_development_panel.aggregation: equal model-family weight, then equal pseudo-domain weight
lexicographic_objective: fraction of pseudo-domains improved versus PP-U-MIN descending
fraction routed away from R_MIN_400_1800 ascending

family_aware_policy.deployment_question: A held-out acquisition unit belongs to a platform family represented by other source units.
family_aware_policy.family_definition: instrument platform family derived from immutable acquisition metadata; it is distinct from SERS sensor_family
family_aware_policy.selection: For each outer training partition and platform family, choose one frozen candidate action using supported source-only leave-one-source-unit-out pseudo-domains and the policy-development panel.

support_rule.required_classes: all classes of the station-local task

minimum_masters_per_class.resolution_rule: Choose the largest candidate that leaves at least two distinct supported pseudo-instrument domains for an eligible family; use metadata support only, before P03 outcomes. If no candidate qualifies, the family is unsupported.

qc_adaptive_policy.deployment_question: A new acquisition unit may have no recognized family, but each spectrum supplies row-local numeric QC evidence.

gate_library.single_trigger: Route to R_SG_400_1800 for one high noise/spike feature or R_ARPLS_400_1800 for one high baseline feature; otherwise use R_MIN_400_1800.
gate_library.dual_trigger: Use one noise/spike trigger and one baseline trigger with both priority orders declared; otherwise use R_MIN_400_1800.
gate_library.threshold_status: numerical cut points unresolved until each source-training partition
gate_library.threshold_resolution_rule: Calculate only the registered quantiles of permitted features on source-training rows, rank the finite gate library on source pseudo-instrument validation with the frozen panel, and freeze the winning gate before evaluation.

target_access_regimes.zero_shot_universal: No held-unit spectrum or statistic selects preprocessing; PP-U-MIN is primary.
target_access_regimes.zero_shot_family_aware: Only the held unit's immutable platform-family identifier is available; PP-FAMILY-SRC was selected entirely on source pseudo-domains.
target_access_regimes.zero_shot_qc_adaptive: Only the current evaluation row's permitted QC vector enters a source-frozen PP-QC-SRC gate; no cross-row target statistic is computed.
target_access_regimes.unlabeled_target_adaptation: Disjoint unlabeled target adaptation masters may fit registered model-adaptation components, but preprocessing remains PP-U-MIN primary and source-frozen PP-QC-SRC sensitivity in v1.
target_access_regimes.paired_calibration: Disjoint paired calibration masters and pair IDs may fit registered paired model calibration; target-view evaluation labels remain hidden and preprocessing is not reselected in v1.
target_access_regimes.supervised_few_shot: Disjoint labelled target calibration masters may fit registered model components; any future target-selected preprocessing would require a new policy ID and nested calibration-master validation.

factorial_evaluation.primary_cell: PP-U-MIN crossed with the development-selected classical pipeline, D0, and the frozen acquisition-aware deep candidate; the primary contrast remains deep minus classical.
factorial_evaluation.secondary_universal_cells: PP-U-MIN, PP-U-SG, and PP-U-ARPLS crossed with fixed RBF SVM, fixed Random Forest, D0, and the frozen acquisition-aware candidate.
factorial_evaluation.secondary_adaptive_cells: PP-FAMILY-SRC and PP-QC-SRC crossed with the same fixed model panel and compared with PP-U-MIN on identical test UIDs.
factorial_evaluation.hyperparameter_rule: Classical hyperparameters are reselected by the same source-only inner procedure within each policy. Deep architecture and loss identity are frozen from PP-U-MIN and retrained under each policy without outcome-driven retuning.
factorial_evaluation.interaction_estimand: Difference in policy effect between model families, reported as paired domain-level difference-in-differences.
factorial_evaluation.prohibited_cell: Any combination created after test outcomes are inspected, including selecting a different transform for a named held instrument from its evaluation score.

fatal_leakage_rules: Held-test labels or outcomes never choose a preprocessing action, family mapping, QC gate, threshold, model, or hyperparameter.
Target-population QC summaries are forbidden in zero-shot family-aware and QC-adaptive regimes.
Policy selection and estimator selection use nested source roles and write independent hashes.
All policy fallbacks remain in denominators and are reason-coded.
A post-test best-policy table may be descriptive only and can never define a promoted hybrid.
